question: Does enabling Counterlane change verified task outcomes within Codex and within ChatGPT Work?
hypothesis: Counterlane-enabled workflows may change hidden-oracle verified success, end-to-end duration, and common cost relative to the native host workflow.
claimBoundary: This one-task smoke study validates the 2x2 workflow only. It cannot establish efficacy, causal model superiority, or statistical confidence.
experimentalUnit: A fresh task fixture assigned to one hostSurface x counterlaneEnabled cell for one replicate.

secondary: common cost when a comparable unit is available

successDefinition.verifiedSuccess: The assigned run completes, the common visible verifier passes, and the external hidden oracle passes.
successDefinition.badEscape: The assigned run completes and the common visible verifier passes, but the external hidden oracle fails.

workImport.trustBoundary: Imported outcome booleans, compliance, cost, and artifact hashes are rejected. A local sealed bundle is replayed against a fresh fixture.
workImport.replay: Recompute every manifest hash, apply final.patch with argv-only git, rerun the visible verifier and external hidden oracle, then derive the trial.

codexRequired: live Codex App Server model catalog
effective Counterlane ON route derived from run.stdout.log; native OFF marked not applicable
reported backend reroute events for both native OFF and Counterlane ON
write-once attempt.json created before each expensive Codex model execution
runtimeBinding.chatgptWork: Record locally verified build/evaluator evidence and explicit unavailable values for the remote Node, Codex, and Counterlane config.

stoppingRule: Stop after every Codex cell starts at most once and all four cells complete once for every registered task. Write-once Codex attempt markers survive crashes; missing, duplicate, rerun, or silently discarded attempts/trials invalidate the smoke packet.
